criteria.notes: Photo-led employee recognition remains primary across all requested ratios, with achievements second and metadata third.
No user reference was supplied; the authored Paper Kite editorial direction is consistently realized.
Asymmetric lead/support silhouettes, offset folio, geometric paper mark, and print-like color blocks create a specific studio identity.
Names and achievements retain strong size and hierarchy at full-screen, strip, portrait, square, and compact fallback dimensions.
Light and dark presets keep masthead, folio, colored tiles, and supporting labels readable without fixed dark-only literals.
Long names, achievements, teams, roles, masthead text, and quotes remain contained with safe prefixes and complete descender ink.
Single, two-person, odd-five, balanced prime-seven, final-page, portrait, square, wide-low, and 960x540 compositions are intentional and stable.
Fictional portraits are sharp and use useful crops; missing and failed media resolve to designed initials mosaics without browser image artifacts.
The app avoids equal KPI cards, dashboard framing, top-right page dots, and the boilerplate examples' standard header grammar.

screenshots.notes: Five-person primary mosaic has a dominant portrait, readable hierarchy, and balanced support tiles.
Compact fallback uses two-person pagination and preserves the full masthead title.
Tall lead feature and two supporting tiles use the full portrait canvas without collisions.
Deep green canvas and coordinated cards preserve contrast and the upbeat editorial tone.
Empty state remains branded, centered, and purposeful without simulating recognition rows.
Final three-person page expands into an asymmetric complete composition with correct folio.
Updated name and achievement render immediately; transient media uses the intentional initials treatment.
Stress copy remains bounded with complete masthead text and intentional secondary ellipsis.
Two media failures become distinct initials compositions while valid portraits remain intact.
Odd count fills the primary surface with one lead and four supporting recognitions.
First balanced page shows four recognitions with a deliberate non-equal silhouette.
Processed row-array input matches the compact two-person visual contract.
Single recognition expands into a full photo-and-story feature rather than a stranded tile.
Two recognitions form a clear asymmetric horizontal editorial pair.
Two-person square page keeps portraits, achievements, quotes, and folio readable.
Wide-low page emphasizes three recognitions and uses the strip without dashboard compression.
